questions.question: On selling an article for Rs. 984, Arun loses 18%. In order to gain 15%, he must sell it for:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP = Rs. 984 

Loss occurred(L) = 18%

Desired profit(P) = 15%

**Formula used:**

CP = SP/(100 - L%) x 100

Also,

SP = CP x (100 + P%)/100

**Calculation:**

CP = 984/(100 - 18) x 100 = Rs. 1200

Selling Price after 15% Profit

SP = 1200 x (100 + 15)/100 = Rs.1380

**Hence,**

**SP is Rs.1380.**

questions.question: The simple interest on a certain sum of money at the rate of 7.5% p.a. for 8 years is Rs. 4,080. At what rate of interest can the same amount of interest be received on the same sum for 5 years?

Given:

Simple Interest (SI) = 4080, Time (T) = 8 Year, Rate (r1) = 7.5% 

Formula Used:

Simple Interest (SI) = PRT/ 100

Where, SI = Simple Interest, P = Principal, T = Time, R = Rate

**Calculation: **

According to the question,

The same amount of interest be received on the same sum for 5 years then,

⇒ 4080 = P × 7.5 × 8/100

⇒ P = Rs 6800

Now,

New Time (T) = 5 Years and same interest and sum

Then,

R = (SI × 100) / PT

⇒ R = (4080 × 100) / 6800 × 5

⇒ **R = 12%**

**Hence, Rate (R) = **12%

questions.question: The average age of 26 students in a class is 15 years. If teacher's age is included in it, then the average will increase by one. What is the teacher's age (in years)?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Average age of 26 students = 15 years

Increased average = 1

**Calculation:**

Total sum of age = 26 × 15 = 390

Let the age of teacher = x year

Then average increased after teacher age included = 15 + 1 = 16

Now total sum of age of students (included teacher) = 16 × 27 = 432

**∴ Teacher's age(x)** = 432 - 390 = **42 years**

questions.question: A money lender finds that due to a fall in the annual rate of interest from 10% to 8(3)/(4)%, his year's income diminishes by Rs. 84.50. Find his capital.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial Rate(R₁) = 10%

Final Rate(R₂) = 8{3over4}% = {35over 4} %

**Formula used:**

Diminishing Income** = (Ptimes R₁ times T)/(100) - (Ptimes R₂times T )/(100) **

**Calculation:**

R₁ = 10%

R₂ = 8{3over4} % = {35over 4} %

The difference in Simple Interest = Rs. 84.50

Rightarrow(Ptimes R₁ times T)/(100) - (Ptimes R₂times T )/(100)=84.50 

Rightarrow(Ptimes 10 times 1)/(100) - (Ptimes 8.75times 1 )/(100)=84.50 

P = Rs. 6760

Hence,

Capital is Rs. 6760.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ 10\%-8.75\% = 84.50

⇒ 1.25\%=84.50 

**⇒ 100% = 6760.**

questions.question: A car is moving at a uniform speed of 35 km/h. What is the time it takes to cover 140 km?
questions.solution:

Speed = 35 km/h, 

Distance = 140 km

**Concept:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ 140/35 = 4 hour

⇒ 4 × 60 = 240 minutes

questions.question: Two candidates are contesting in an election. All votes are valid votes. A candidate who gets 38% of votes is rejected by 28,800 votes. The total number of votes polled is:
questions.solution:

A candidate who gets 38% of the votes is rejected by 28,800 votes.

Calculation:

Let the total votes polled be x.

The number of votes the winner gets = 62% of x

⇒ 62xover100 

Number of votes received by the lost candidates = 38% of x

⇒ 38xover100 

Difference,

62xover100 - 38xover100 = 2,88,00

⇒ 24xover100 = 2,88,00

⇒ x = {2,88,00 times 100}over24 = 1,20,000

**∴ The total number of votes polled is 1,20,000.**

Rejected candidates gets vote 38%

Selected candidate gets vote (100 - 38)% = 62%

Difference between both candidates vote = 62% - 38% = 24%

Value of 24 % = 28,800

⇒ 1% = 28,800 / 24 =1200

⇒ 100% = 1200 × 100 = 1,20,000 (Total vote)

**∴ Option 4 is correct.**

questions.question: The average age of 66(2)/(3)% of the number of children in a group is 13 years. The average age of all the children in the group is 14.5 years. What is the average age (in years) of the remaining children?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of the group is 66{2over3} %.

The average age of all groups is 14.5 years.

Formula used:

Average = (Sum of the observations) / (Number of observations)

Calculation:

The average of the group = 66{2over3}% = {200over3}×{1over100} = 2over3

The average of 2 children out of 3 is13.

So, The total age of 2 children = 13 × 2 = 26 years

And The total age of 3 children = 14.5 × 3 = 43.5 years

The average age of the remaining children = 43.5 – 26 = 17.5 years

**∴ Option 4 is correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The average of the group = 66{2over3}% = 2over3 

⇒ x + 2 × 13 = 14.5 × 3

⇒ x + 26 = 43.5

⇒ x = 43.5 – 26 = 17.5

**∴ The average age of the remaining children is 17.5 years.**

questions.question: A can complete 25% of the work in 4 days, B can complete 50% of the same work in 12 days and C can complete the same work in 32 days. They started working together but C left after 4 days of the start and A left 6 days before the completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A 25% work in 4 days.

B 50% work in 12 days.

C 100% work in 32 days.

**Formula Used:** ** **

Work Done = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:** 

A 100% work in 16 days. 

B 100% work in 24 days.

C 100% work in 32 days.

Total Work Done = LCM(16,24,32) = 96

Efficiency of A = 6

Efficiency of B = 4

Efficiency of C = 3

⇒ (A + B + C) × 4 + (A + B) × (x - 10) + (6) × B = 96

 ⇒ 13 × 4 + 10 × ( x - 10) + 6 × 4 = 96

⇒ 52 + 10x - 100 + 24 = 96

 ⇒ 76 + 10x - 100 = 96

 ⇒ 10x - 24 = 96

 ⇒ x = 12 

 ∴ The correct answer is** **12 days.

**∴ The Option 2 is correct.**

questions.question: Jagat Singh sold an article for Rs. 6,000 and incurred a loss. Had he sold it for Rs. 7,400, his profit would have been (2)/(3) of the amount of loss that he incurred. At what price should he sell it to gain 25% profit?

First Selling Price = Rs.6,000 

Second Selling Price = Rs. 7,400 

Profit of second Selling Price = 2/3 of Loss of the first SP

CP = SP - Profit

CP = SP + Loss

Also, SP = CP x (100 + P)/100

**Calculation:**

Let Loss be 3x

⇒ Profit = 2x

Now, according to the statement

6000 + 3x = 7400 - 2x

⇒ x = 280

⇒ Profit = 2x = 560

⇒ CP = 7400 - 560 = 6840 

Now, SP for 25 % Profit = 6840 x (100 + 25)/100

⇒ SP = 8550

∴ To gain 25 % he should sell the article at 8550 Rs.

⇒ x = 6840

Now, SP = 6840 (100 + 25) / 100 = 8550

**∴ Required SP is 8550.**

questions.question: If the surface areas of two spheres are in the ratio of 4 ∶ 25, then find the ratio of their volumes.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area Ratio (S₁:S₂) = (Radius Ratio)² = 4 : 25

Radius Ratio (r₁:r₂) = √4 : √25 = 2 : 5

Volume Ratio (V₁:V₂) = (Radius Ratio)³ = 2³ : 5³

Required Ratio = 8 : 125

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of surface areas of two spheres = 4 : 25

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

Volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

 
 
 
• 
 r₁
 Area = 4k
 
 
 
 
• 
 r₂
 Area = 25k

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the radii of the two spheres be r₁ and r₂.

⇒ (4 × π × r₁²) ÷ (4 × π × r₂²) = 4 ÷ 25

⇒ r₁² ÷ r₂² = 4 ÷ 25

⇒ r₁ ÷ r₂ = √(4 ÷ 25) = 2 ÷ 5

⇒ Volume Ratio = [(4/3) × π × r₁³] ÷ [(4/3) × π × r₂³]

⇒ Volume Ratio = (r₁ ÷ r₂)³

⇒ Volume Ratio = (2 ÷ 5)³ = 8 ÷ 125

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere and Hemisphere

For a sphere of radius r, Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4/3)πr³. For a hemisphere, Curved Surface Area = 2πr² and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Scaling Rules for 3D Shapes

If the linear dimensions (like radius) are in ratio a:b, then areas are in ratio a²:b² and volumes are in ratio a³:b³. This applies to all similar solids like cubes, spheres, and cylinders.

Direct Relation between Area and Volume

The ratio of volumes of two spheres can be calculated from the ratio of their surface areas (S₁/S₂) using the formula: V₁/V₂ = (S₁/S₂)³/².</p

questions.question: A man travelled a distance of 47 km in 6 hours. He travelled partly on foot at a speed of 6(1)/(2) km/h and the rest on bicycle at a speed of 8(1)/(2) km/h. The distance travelled (in km) on bicycle is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Alligation method on speeds to find the time ratio:

Average speed = 47/6 km/h | Foot speed = 13/2 = 39/6 km/h | Bicycle speed = 17/2 = 51/6 km/h

Time Ratio (Foot : Bicycle) = (51/6 − 47/6) : (47/6 − 39/6) = 4/6 : 8/6 = 1 : 2

Total time = 6 hours → Time spent on bicycle = (2/3) × 6 = 4 hours

Distance travelled on bicycle = Speed × Time = 8.5 × 4 = 34 km

**∴ The correct answer is 34 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 47 km

Total time = 6 hours

Speed on foot = 6.5 km/h

Speed on bicycle = 8.5 km/h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d01cac8c561670f583d1b1ceb19007bfef1e8b63229ad60229e49ec751bdb68.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

Let the time travelled on foot be t hours.

⇒ Time travelled on bicycle = (6 − t) hours.

⇒ Distance travelled on foot = 6.5 × t

⇒ Distance travelled on bicycle = 8.5 × (6 − t)

⇒ Total distance = 6.5t + 8.5(6 − t)

⇒ 6.5t + 51 − 8.5t = 47

⇒ 51 − 47 = 8.5t − 6.5t

⇒ 4 = 2t

⇒ t = 2 hours

So, the time spent on the bicycle is 6 − 2 = 4 hours.

⇒ Distance travelled on bicycle = 8.5 × 4 = 34 km

**∴ The correct answer is 34 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If a journey is split into two equal distances travelled at speeds S₁ and S₂, then Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Alligation on Speed

When the rule of alligation is applied to the speeds of two parts of a journey, the resulting ratio represents the ratio of the time taken for those parts, not the ratio of distances.

Relative Speed

If two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their speeds (S₁ − S₂). If they move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).
</p
